reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness media plugin providing image analysis/OCR, image generation and editing, and video generation through Xiapan Cloud, with workspace file outputs and approval-gated paid calls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供识图、OCR、图像生成与编辑以及视频生成功能，并将媒体产物保存到工作区。
summaries.en: Adds image understanding and OCR, image generation and editing, and video generation to DeepSeek Harness with media outputs saved in the workspace.

capabilities: Analyzes images through vision, OCR, and location tools
Generates or edits images through an external API
Generates videos through an external API
Reads workspace input files and writes generated media files
Uses external credentials and may make paid API calls subject to approval settings
